offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes, mainly to first-time and entry-level buyers, in master-planned communities. It acquires and develops land, builds the homes, and offers mortgage and title services to buyers.

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title services; home design and customization

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time and entry-level homebuyers, move-up buyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of newly built homes to buyers; service fees: mortgage origination and title fees charged to homebuyers

value_chain_position.value: other: acquires and develops land, then builds and sells homes to individual buyers; financial intermediary: arranges mortgage loans for its homebuyers, sold to lenders

geography_served.value: US regional: Florida, Texas, Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee and Arizona

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding, mortgage origination and title services for the same homebuyers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: model homes and sales offices in its communities; direct sales: in-house sales staff selling to homebuyers; agents / brokers: outside real estate agents who bring buyers to its communities; online: website listings and online home reservations
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, licensing for mortgage and title operations, and consumer lending rules such as RESPA and TILA

notes: Geographic list and size category are my best understanding and may be incomplete or out of date.
